title: Cloud leases assume clocks lie a little
body: Distributed locks are usually leases with expiry times because clock skew makes absolute deadlines untrustworthy across machines; Google's Spanner exposes time uncertainty explicitly for the same reason. A client that cannot renew in time must assume it lost the lock while possibly still running. Fencing tokens exist to stop exactly that zombie. Time in the cloud is a rumour with error bars.
source_hint: Chubby / Spanner literature on leases and time
